Preview: Road & Weather page changes

What changes
  • Weather alerts, the forecast and roads now refresh every 5 minutes, all the time (before: every hour, and every 5 minutes only during winter alerts). Resort snow reports stay hourly, and every 5 minutes during winter alerts.
  • New Ben's Weather Look card at the top of Valley weather. Ben changes with the forecast.
  • Ben's Road Report now has more than one Ben for snow and ice.
  • When a set has more than one Ben, they take turns every 15 minutes, and the page checks again every 5 minutes even if someone leaves it open.
  • The page's "updated every hour" labels now say "every 5 minutes."
Nothing else on the page changes.

How it looks right now (test copy of the page)

Road Report: UDOT shows icy pavement on I-84 at Weber Canyon (25°F), so the snow/ice Bens are up.

Weather Look: dry in the Valley today, but Snowbasin's latest report shows 9" new, so the fresh-snow Bens are up.

Weather Bens, by weather

Snow in the Valley (forecast says snow, or a winter alert)

March to May also adds the 'Spring has a return policy' Ben.

Rain (40% chance or more)

Wind (20 mph or more, or 'breezy/windy' in the forecast)

Cold (low 15° or colder, or high 28° or colder)

Fresh snow on the mountains, dry in the Valley (a resort reports 4"+ in 24 hours, Nov. to April)

Hot (85° or warmer)

June to August also adds the mosquito Ben.

Clear / everyday

Road Bens, by road condition

Snow on the roads

Already on the site: the chains Ben. New: plow Ben and Go slow Ben.

Ice on the roads (UDOT sensor shows ice)

Closed / crash / road work / all clear

One Ben each for now (same as today). We can add more.

The pictures come from your Canva sets "Ben La Moose - Snow Set" and "01 Weather - Ben the Moose." New Bens can be added to any set anytime.
